pages.text: Not every gift is brewed in the Matrix. An Assimilation needs no Mutagen, no vessel and no ritual: the Maw simply drinks it from the world the moment its hunter completes a deed, whatever the beast's Stage. Five exist, scattered across the Stages.

These traits cling to the hunter, not to the vessel. A replacement Maw benefits at once and death takes nothing away, but their power slumbers unless a Maw is carried. Hover over the beast to see how many you have taken in.
